name: Naturalidad de Cejas
algorithm: Eyebrow Naturalness — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes eyebrow movement patterns for deepfake detection:

1. **Eyebrow Landmark Seguimiento**: Precise eyebrow landmarks are tracked per frame, measuring: arch height, arch position, medial endpoint, lateral endpoint, and brow thickness. These geometric parameters capture eyebrow shape and position with sub-pixel accuracy.

2. **Brow Movement Dynamics**: Eyebrow movements are analyzed for naturalness — raise speed, lowering speed, asymmetric movement patterns. Natural brow movements follow physiological constraints of the frontalis and corrugator muscles. Deepfake generators may produce brow movements that are too symmetric, too fast/slow, or follow unnatural trajectories.

3. **Brow - Expression Coordination**: Eyebrow position is tightly coupled with facial expressions — surprise raises brows, anger lowers them, skepticism raises one brow. The method verifies temporal coordination between brow position and other facial features (eyes, mouth). Deepfakes may show decoupled brow-expression dynamics.

4. **Brow Textura & Cabello Detail**: Individual eyebrow hairs should be visible in high-resolution video and maintain consistent texture across frames. The method analyzes brow texture quality — AI generators often produce smoothed brow regions lacking individual hair detail or showing temporally inconsistent hair rendering.

5. **Bilateral Brow Simetría**: Natural eyebrows show characteristic bilateral asymmetry that remains consistent. The method tracks left-right brow asymmetry — deepfakes may produce brow movements with incorrect asymmetry patterns (too symmetric or varying asymmetry frame-to-frame). The score combines dynamic naturalness, coordination, texture quality, and symmetry analysis.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante eyebrow naturalness analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Matern, F. et al. (2019). Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes. WACVW.
